details.expected: Explicit cache hooks and repeated module imports reuse the same PrismaClient in one process.
Initialization and connection errors become DatabaseUnavailableError without URL, credential, raw cause or log leakage.
Production ignores and never writes global cache; development and test share cached instances.

Real isolated PostgreSQL checks User defaults, all fields, enum/index inventory, revision/sessionVersion nonnegative constraints, timestamps independent of revision, canonical email uniqueness and normalizer boundaries.
Generated node_modules/.prisma/client exists, matches Prisma 6.19.0 and the exact User model schema.
TypeScript imports User/Role/UserStatus, proves nonoptional revision/sessionVersion and rejects third roles, invalid statuses and alias fields.

Separate disposable schema/database mutations remove email uniqueness and canonical CHECK; each makes the same constraint assertions fail with an unexpected successful write; restored constraints and assertions pass.

Adding a third Role only in a disposable schema produces a real new migrate-dev migration containing ALTER TYPE; restore with the original migration chain in a fresh disposable database and recheck enum/status.
Removing global cache reuse only in a disposable source copy makes the same module/cache identity assertion fail; restored code passes.
npm run db:generate exits zero and generated index.d.ts exports User including revision.

Verify the disposable loopback database and container identity before npm run db:migrate -- --name init_user; the generated migration includes canonical email and nonnegative version CHECKs and applies without db push.
npx prisma migrate status exits zero with Database schema is up to date; PostgreSQL major is 17.
npm run db:studio serves real Prisma Studio on loopback; locked Playwright opens User, verifies every field, saves DOM and screenshot, and blocks public requests.

notEvaluated: Login, registration, seed, session validation and HTTP 503 mapping belong to later authorized phases; this card creates no API, UI page or other business model.
Production traffic and real user data are not evaluated.
